{{Top|ca|leg}}
The '''Arized homeworld''' was the origin point of the group known as the [[Arized]]. After the celestial body was [[Extermination of the Arized homeworld|exterminated]] by the [[Vagaari Empire]], the [[Surfeik cruiser]]s [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] by Arized [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] became [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] property, eventually becoming part of their [[Vagaari slaver fleet|fleet]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Arized [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
